scope.condition: Short localized ad speech with music and tight head/tail crops

hypothesis: ASR and comparative audio models can disagree on short localized ad phrases and timestamps when music, tight crops and mixed speech are present. APC-20261117-060 supports using the final script, measured mix boundaries and actual encoded audio as the deciding evidence while retaining model disagreement as a limitation.
limitations: Spanish, German and French showed lexical or timing disagreement across Whisper, raw TTS and Gemini evidence; Portuguese Gemini hallucinated CTA timing; the complete takes were retained in the encoded mixes.
No direct continuous normal-speed listening or independent native-speaker acceptance was performed.
This observation does not establish a model ranking or a universal timing tolerance.
The candidate records a bounded review method and remains pending broader evidence.
promotion: Keep as a source-scoped candidate; do not promote a model hierarchy or waive encoded audio review.
evidence_boundary: Exact source, mix and locale scope; new productions require their own script, mix, head/tail and encoded review.
